title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

series.title: Exchanging a Leopard Cat for a Prince

fullText.simplified:
第二十八章、白旗密语

    包拯和公孙策在开封府里说话，他们说到了八王爷和皇帝，也说到了多年前就去世了的王妃。
    包拯问公孙策：“王妃是什么时候去世的？”
    “你不知道吗？王妃身子弱，生完孩子就病了，没一个月就去世了。这件事全国百姓都知道吧！这么说八王爷真不容易，王妃死后他也没有再结婚，一个人把孩子养大，真是既当父亲，又当母亲啊！”公孙策说。
    “那个孩子也很可怜，刚出生就没了母亲。”包拯说。
    公孙策忍不住笑了：“你是说皇上可怜吗？虽然没有母亲，但他有爱他的父亲啊！不管是八王爷，还是先皇，都是真心爱他的呢，我觉得他比很多人幸运多了。”
    “你说得对。”包拯笑着摆摆头，像是扔掉了一些可笑的想法。
    “现在没时间说这些，接下来我们应该怎么办呢？去哪儿找证据？”公孙策问。
    “你去准备一下，现在我们去一个地方。”
    “哪儿？”
    “西市菜市场。”
    夜已经深了，天空暗沉，没有一丝星光，但西市菜市场门口却灯火通明。人们激动地大喊：“开封府的包大人把登闻鼓搬到菜市场来了！”好奇的人越聚越多，他们像海水一样围在菜市场大门前面。
    人群中间，包拯和公孙策正在整理办公桌，桌子旁边放着一面巨大的鼓，这就是有名的登闻鼓。登闻鼓平时放在开封府的大门口，百姓们都知道，不管是谁，只要有冤屈，上去敲一敲，包大人都会为他找回公道。现在这面鼓放在了菜市场门口，人们围着鼓大声议论着。
    “包大人为什么把登闻鼓放在这儿？”
    “那还用问？肯定是包大人希望有人来敲鼓，他在等敲鼓的人！”
    “包大人在等谁？包大人要在这儿办案吗？”
    “不知道啊，最近有什么大案吗？”
    “是不是八王爷被绑架的案子？现在还有什么案子比这个大吗？”
    “对啊！啊……快看，包大人在做什么？”
    议论的人群顺着指点望向高处，只见包拯爬到了菜市场大门的门头上面，他从胸前的衣服里拿出一块白色的布，打开后挂在了门头上的一根长木杆上面。那块白布原来是面白旗，上面写了几个黑色的大字。一阵寒风吹过，白旗伸展，那几个字就清清楚楚地显露了出来——“狸猫换太子”。
    “狸猫换太子”，人们疑惑地读着这五个字，不知道是什么意思。有头发花白的老人回忆起什么，吃惊地张大了嘴，但就是不敢将心里的话说出来。
fullText.traditional:
第二十八章、白旗密語

    包拯和公孫策在開封府裡說話，他們說到了八王爺和皇帝，也說到了多年前就去世了的王妃。
    包拯問公孫策：“王妃是什麼時候去世的？”
    “你不知道嗎？王妃身子弱，生完孩子就病了，沒一個月就去世了。這件事全國百姓都知道吧！這麼說八王爺真不容易，王妃死後他也沒有再結婚，一個人把孩子養大，真是既當父親，又當母親啊！”公孫策說。
    “那個孩子也很可憐，剛出生就沒了母親。”包拯說。
    公孫策忍不住笑了：“你是說皇上可憐嗎？雖然沒有母親，但他有愛他的父親啊！不管是八王爺，還是先皇，都是真心愛他的呢，我覺得他比很多人幸運多了。”
    “你說得對。”包拯笑著擺擺頭，像是扔掉了一些可笑的想法。
    “現在沒時間說這些，接下來我們應該怎麼辦呢？去哪兒找證據？”公孫策問。
    “你去準備一下，現在我們去一個地方。”
    “哪兒？”
    “西市菜市場。”
    夜已經深了，天空暗沉，沒有一絲星光，但西市菜市場門口卻燈火通明。人們激動地大喊：“開封府的包大人把登聞鼓搬到菜市場來了！”好奇的人越聚越多，他們像海水一樣圍在菜市場大門前面。
    人群中間，包拯和公孫策正在整理辦公桌，桌子旁邊放著一面巨大的鼓，這就是有名的登聞鼓。登聞鼓平時放在開封府的大門口，百姓們都知道，不管是誰，只要有冤屈，上去敲一敲，包大人都會為他找回公道。現在這面鼓放在了菜市場門口，人們圍著鼓大聲議論著。
    “包大人為什麼把登聞鼓放在這兒？”
    “那還用問？肯定是包大人希望有人來敲鼓，他在等敲鼓的人！”
    “包大人在等誰？包大人要在這兒辦案嗎？”
    “不知道啊，最近有什麼大案嗎？”
    “是不是八王爺被綁架的案子？現在還有什麼案子比這個大嗎？”
    “對啊！啊……快看，包大人在做什麼？”
    議論的人群順著指點望向高處，只見包拯爬到了菜市場大門的門頭上面，他從胸前的衣服裡拿出一塊白色的布，打開後掛在了門頭上的一根長木杆上面。那塊白布原來是面白旗，上面寫了幾個黑色的大字。一陣寒風吹過，白旗伸展，那幾個字就清清楚楚地顯露了出來——“狸貓換太子”。
    “狸貓換太子”，人們疑惑地讀著這五個字，不知道是什麼意思。有頭髮花白的老人回憶起什麼，吃驚地張大了嘴，但就是不敢將心裡的話說出來。

sentences.pinyin: tā cóng xiōng qián de yī fu lǐ ná chū yí kuài bái sè de bù dǎ kāi hòu guà zài le mén tóu shang de yì gēn cháng mù gān shàng miàn
sentences.english: He took out a piece of white cloth from the front of his shirt, unfolded it, and hung it on a long wooden pole above the gate.

sentences.simplified: 那块白布原来是面白旗，上面写了几个黑色的大字。
sentences.traditional: 那塊白布原來是面白旗，上面寫了幾個黑色的大字。
sentences.pinyin: nà kuài bái bù yuán lái shì miàn bái qí shàng miàn xiě le jǐ ge hēi sè de dà zì
sentences.english: The piece of white cloth turned out to be a white banner with several large black characters written on it.

sentences.simplified: 一阵寒风吹过，白旗伸展，那几个字就清清楚楚地显露了出来——“狸猫换太子”。
sentences.traditional: 一陣寒風吹過，白旗伸展，那幾個字就清清楚楚地顯露了出來——“狸貓換太子”。
sentences.pinyin: yí zhèn hán fēng chuī guò bái qí shēn zhǎn nà jǐ ge zì jiù qīng qīng chu chu de xiǎn lù le chu lai lí māo huàn tài zǐ
sentences.english: A gust of cold wind blew, and the white banner unfurled, clearly revealing the characters: “exchanging a leopard cat for a prince”.

sentences.simplified: “狸猫换太子”，人们疑惑地读着这五个字，不知道是什么意思。
sentences.traditional: “狸貓換太子”，人們疑惑地讀著這五個字，不知道是什麼意思。
sentences.pinyin: lí māo huàn tài zǐ rén men yí huò de dú zhe zhè wǔ ge zì bù zhī dào shì shén me yì si
sentences.english: “Exchanging a leopard cat for a prince”, people read these five characters in bewilderment, not understanding what they meant.

sentences.simplified: 有头发花白的老人回忆起什么，吃惊地张大了嘴，
sentences.traditional: 有頭髮花白的老人回憶起什麼，吃驚地張大了嘴，
sentences.pinyin: yǒu tóu fa huā bái de lǎo rén huí yì qǐ shén me chī jīng de zhāng dà le zuǐ
sentences.english: An old man with graying hair seemed to recall something, his mouth opening in astonishment, ..

sentences.simplified: 但就是不敢将心里的话说出来。
sentences.traditional: 但就是不敢將心裡的話說出來。
sentences.pinyin: dàn jiù shì bù gǎn jiāng xīn li de huà shuō chu lai
sentences.english: .. but he didn’t dare to say out what was on his mind.

sentence_translations: Chapter 28: The Secret Code of the White Banner
Bao Zheng and Gongsun Ce were talking in Kaifeng Mansion.
They talked about the Eighth Prince and the emperor and also talked about the princess consort who had passed away many years ago.
Bao Zheng asked Gongsun Ce, “When did the princess consort pass away?”
“Didn’t you know? The princess consort was frail. She fell ill after giving birth and passed away within a month.
This is something everyone in the country knows!
It wasn’t easy for the Eighth Prince. After the death of the princess consort, he didn’t remarry and raised his child on his own.
He truly had to be both a father and a mother!” Gongsun Ce said.
“That child was also very pitiful, losing his mother soon after he was born,” Bao Zheng said.
Gongsun Ce couldn’t help but smile:
“Are you saying the emperor is pitiful? Although he doesn’t have a mother, he has a father who loves him!
Whether it was the Eighth Prince or the late emperor, they both truly loved him. I think he’s more fortunate than many people.”
“You are right.” Bao Zheng smiled and shook his head, as if discarding some ridiculous thoughts.
“There’s no time to talk about this now. What should we do next? Where can we find evidence?” Gongsun Ce asked.
“Get ready. We’re heading somewhere now.”
“Where?”
“The West Market.”
The night was late, and the sky was dark and heavy, without a trace of starlight.
But the entrance to the West Market was brightly lit.
People excitedly shouted, “Lord Bao of Kaifeng Mansion has moved the petitioners’ drum to the market!”
The curious crowd kept growing, swelling in front of the market gate like a rising tide.
In the middle of the crowd, Bao Zheng and Gongsun Ce were arranging a desk.
There was a huge drum next to the desk. This was the famous petitioners’ drum.
The petitioners’ drum was usually placed at the entrance of Kaifeng Mansion.
Ordinary people knew that no matter who they were, if they had been treated unjustly, they could beat the drum, ..
.. and Lord Bao would always help them seek justice.
The drum was now placed at the entrance of the market, and people gathered around it, talking loudly.
“Why did Lord Bao put the petitioners’ drum here?”
“Isn’t it obvious? Of course, Lord Bao hopes someone will come to beat the drum. He is waiting for that person to beat the drum!”
“Who is Lord Bao waiting for? Is Lord Bao going to investigate a case here?”
“I don’t know. Have there been any major cases recently?”
“Could it be the case of the Eighth Prince’s kidnapping? Is there any case bigger than this right now?”
“Yes, that’s right! Ah … Look, what is Lord Bao doing?”
The people who were talking followed the direction of the pointed finger and looked up, ..
.. only to see that Bao Zheng had climbed to the top of the market gate.
He took out a piece of white cloth from the front of his shirt, unfolded it, and hung it on a long wooden pole above the gate.
The piece of white cloth turned out to be a white banner with several large black characters written on it.
A gust of cold wind blew, and the white banner unfurled, clearly revealing the characters: “exchanging a leopard cat for a prince”.
“Exchanging a leopard cat for a prince”, people read these five characters in bewilderment, not understanding what they meant.
An old man with graying hair seemed to recall something, his mouth opening in astonishment, ..
.. but he didn’t dare to say out what was on his mind.
